title: Ruleset
description: Integer parameters of the relational graph engine's update rule.

coupling_divisor.description: Divisor applied to the weighted neighbour sum.

memory_length.description: Number of past states each vertex remembers.

persistence_threshold.description: A vertex is persistent when |state| >= this for the whole memory window.

perturbation_magnitude.description: Maximum absolute size of a perturbation.

perturbation_permille.description: Probability (permille) that a vertex is perturbed in a step.

self_retention_permille.description: Retention of a vertex's own state, in permille.
